{{Otheruses|Butter}}
'''Saltnut butter''' was a type of butter from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It tasted good on its own, but when mixed with the taste of [[bluefruit jam]], it was said to be able to induce a [[Sand cat/Legends|sand cat]] to gag.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

It was a favorite of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jos Vondar]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
